planariumview.config.title: Planarium Panorama
planariumview.config.radius.tooltip: Living area around the Planarium: block changes, animations, particles, sounds and mobs. Each block appears 32 times bigger.
planariumview.config.far_radius.tooltip:
How far the scenery goes. Past the detail radius, it is a frozen snapshot (blocks only), hidden while the Planarium moves.

OFF: the scenery stops at the detail radius.
planariumview.config.refresh.tooltip:
A full new snapshot of the scenery, detail radius and view distance. It also catches what isn't a block (paintings, item frames, armor stands...).

With both OFF, the scenery is a frozen snapshot taken when entering the jar.
planariumview.config.fog.tooltip:
How far the giant scenery goes before it fades into fog.

OFF: no fog, the whole scenery stays visible.

Scenery edge: the scenery fades into fog at its own edge (the view distance), so it has no hard border.

Render distance: the scenery fades into fog at your render distance, like the rest of the world. The frozen snapshot past the detail radius is then not drawn.
planariumview.config.lighting.tooltip:
How light works in the jar.

OFF: same as Ars Nouveau. Everything is fully lit, with no shadows (the giant scenery like the miniature).

Sky and scenery: the jar shows the outside sky and time of day. The giant scenery and the miniature are lit like the real place. The inside of the jar (your blocks, you) stays fully lit.

Full: same as Sky and scenery, and the inside of the jar is also lit like the Planarium's spot outside: darker at night, dark in a cave, lit by the torches next to it (with their color).
planariumview.config.biome.tooltip: The scenery and the jar take on the real biomes around the Planarium: grass, leaves and water colors, and inside the jar the biome's music, ambient sounds and particles.
planariumview.config.color.tooltip: Contraption Lights colored light on the giant scenery and the miniature. Inside the jar, colored light always works, like in the rest of the world.
planariumview.config.ambience.tooltip: Dynamic Surroundings plays the sounds of the Planarium's surroundings, and its biome fog colors show in the jar. Its fireflies also appear around flowers in the miniature and giant scenery when scenery particles are enabled.
planariumview.config.server_controlled: Set by the server you are playing on.
planariumview.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. OFF: everything is like in Ars Nouveau (no giant scenery, black sky, Ars lighting). Your other choices are kept.
planariumview.config.weather.tooltip: Outside rain, snow and lightning: rain and snow fall on the scenery with the rain sound, you hear the thunder and see nearby bolts.
planariumview.config.clouds.tooltip: Outside clouds show up in the jar when the Planarium is close to the cloud layer, giant like the scenery. Follows the Clouds video setting.
planariumview.config.clouds.other_mod: %s is installed: the clouds in the jar will be vanilla clouds, unlike the ones outside. Turn this off if you prefer no clouds in the jar.
planariumview.config.reenter: Some changes only fully apply after leaving and re-entering the jar.
planariumview.config.block_updates.toolt:
Maximum delay before a block change in the detail radius shows up in the scenery. Lower values cost more on busy servers (farms, redstone...).

OFF: only with the backup refresh.
planariumview.config.ambient_sounds.tool: AmbientSounds plays the sounds of the Planarium's surroundings: its biome, weather, height and nearby blocks.
planariumview.config.scenery_particles.t:
Particles of the scenery blocks (torch and campfire smoke, flames, lava, drips...), 32 times bigger like the scenery, and the particles of outside explosions. Also the particles of the miniature inside nearby Planariums, 32 times smaller.

Made on your side and follows Minecraft's Particles setting (fewer with Decreased, none with Minimal).
planariumview.config.scenery_ambience.to:
Ambient sounds of the scenery blocks (fire, lava, flowing water, portals, campfires...), from their direction in the scenery.

Made on your side, like Minecraft does around the player: works even when the outside world is paused.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.toolti: Sounds from the outside world around the Planarium (mobs, redstone, explosions, jukeboxes...), from their direction in the scenery. Sounds caused by a player are excluded.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.warnin: ON: the detail radius keeps running as if you were there (machines, mobs, furnaces). OFF: it is paused, only the scenery ambience remains.
planariumview.config.cave_fog.tooltip:
Fog color around the scenery when the Planarium is in a closed cave.

Vanilla: the fog color of the Planarium's biome, darker at night and in the rain, like vanilla caves.

Dark: black, only deep in a cave with no view of the outside at all. Elsewhere in a cave, the Vanilla color is used.

A biome with its own fog color (like Alex's Caves biomes) always keeps that color.
planariumview.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every option back to its default value. It is saved right away: it can't be undone.
planariumview.config.sub_levels.tooltip:
Show Sable structures in the giant scenery and miniature.

OFF: they are no longer drawn or captured for you. If the Planarium is on a moving structure, the scenery still follows its movement.

If ships do not reappear after switching this back ON, leave and rejoin the world.
planariumview.config.lunar_events.toolti: The jar's moon follows the lunar event of the Planarium's world: blood moon, blue moon, harvest moon... (moon color, size and texture, and the tint of the light). Needs the synced sky (Lighting not OFF).
